summary: National Plan for Epilepsy Act This bill requires the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) to review and update existing federal activities relating to epilepsy research, prevention, diagnosis, and treatment to address knowledge gaps and improve health outcomes. HHS must regularly convene and solicit input from other federal agencies and stakeholders, as appropriate, to inform the review. HHS must report on the findings of the review, including recommendations for changes to existing programs.
